entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. Order number is VF88602.
Okay, I'm pulling that up now. One moment... I see an order for a pair of our Road Cycling Shoes, delivered on January 3rd. Is that correct?
Alright. And to make sure I'm helping in the best way possible, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
They just don't work for me. I wore them once and they gave me terrible blisters.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Sometimes, that can be related to the positioning of the cleats or even just how the shoe is broken in. Are you interested in any troubleshooting tips?
No. I just want a refund. I don't want to mess with the cleats or anything else.
I understand completely. Not a problem at all. Since you're well within the 90-day return window for our cycling shoes, I can certainly process that refund for you. I'm initiating the return now.

I've just sent an email to the address on file. It will contain a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any UPS location. Once we receive them, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Whatever. As long as it gets handled.
It will be. Your return authorization number is RA-951337. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can serve you better in the future. Have a good day.
